newsitem.title: USA: TOSCO RESTARTING BAYWAY CRUDE UNIT - TRADER.
newsitem.headline: TOSCO RESTARTING BAYWAY CRUDE UNIT - TRADER.

text.p: Tosco Corp is in the process of restarting the crude distillation unit at its 250,000 barrels per day (bpd) Bayway refinery in New Jersey, a trader familiar with the plant's operations said on Monday.
The company shut down the unit in mid-July for scheduled maintenance.
"Sometime between now and tomorrow, it should be at 100 percent," the trader said. "They haven't run into any problems."
Separately, the plant's catalytic cracking unit, which was shut down at the end of July after a catalyst leak, is on target to restart on August 16-17, the traders said.
The New Jersey facility normally produces 130,000 bpd of gasoline. As a result of the shutdown of the cat cracker, Tosco has been buying gasoline on the spot market.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
